thread:
maria: quick recap from the authz postmortem — root cause narrowed to token-validator GC pause + JWKS fetch blocking. we need clear owners for: hotfix, longer-term architecture, audit schema additions, secrets rotation, and a short recurrence plan. please add commitments here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AuthzActions

devsec-bot: INCIDENT RDW-2026-318 logged: authz validation spike 2026-03-22 11:12-11:48 UTC. impacted: hosted api + some dedicated eu-west-1 customers. severity: P2. raw logs: https://logs.redwood.example/incident/2026-318

jamie: i'll take the hotfix — implement cache fallback + a circuit-breaker around jwks fetch. aiming EOD Fri 03/26 for patch to staging and deploy to canary.

alex: i'll own telemetry/alerts and the audit log schema change. i'll add a jwks_fetch_latency histogram and a token_validation_verdict event. PR for staging today.

tanya: i'll prep customer comms templates and hold until we confirm the hotfix deploy window.

maria: added the initial rows in the sheet. please update the owner column and add any sub-tasks before EOD tomorrow. highlights:
- hotfix: jamie -> 03/26 EOD
- telemetry & alert tuning: alex -> 03/28
- audit log schema + retention review: alex + devsec -> 03/28
- rotate token-validator service principal + verify secrets: devsec -> 03/28 window
- comms: tanya -> send after hotfix verifies

jamie: notes on short/medium term approaches: short: reduce token-validator heap/G1 tuning (lower pause targets), ensure jwks fetch uses non-blocking IO; medium: extract jwks fetch to a dedicated lightweight sidecar with its own connection pool and limits. i'll add a runbook snippet to the sheet.

alex: proposed audit index: authz.audit with fields: tenant_id, subject_id, token_hash, jwks_fetch_latency_ms, verdict, error_code, cached_jwks_age_s. sample query to surface patterns:
```
index=authz.audit (error_code=JWKS_FETCH_FAIL OR error_code=TOKEN_VALIDATION_ERROR) | stats count by error_code, tenant_id
```
this should separate tenant-specific failures from platform incidents.

infra-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: canary-token-validator v2.1 -> 03/27 02:30 UTC. Rollback rule: >1% 5xx for 10m -> rollback.

devsec-bot: Remediation ticket RDW-SEC-12458 created: rotate service principal and verify secret material for token-validator. Proposed window 03/28 02:00-04:00 UTC.

maria: proposing a temporary "token health" stand-up: start Mon 03/30, 15 minutes weekly for 6 weeks or until metrics stable. i'll send invites. please ack in-thread with :eyes: when you confirm owners in the sheet.

jamie: :eyes: confirmed. i'll paste the runbook snippet now:
```
# token-validator fallback runbook snippet
if jwks_fetch_latency_ms > 500:
  use_cached_jwks()
  backoff_jwks_fetch()
  increment_metrics("jwks_fetch_fail")
if cached_jwks_age_s > 60:
  escalate(alert_team="eng-oncall")
```
will add full runbook to the doc by EOD Fri.

tanya: thanks — i'll wait for jamie's EOD status before sending comms. add me as owner of the comms row.

maria: recap of owners & next steps (please ack):
1) jamie: hotfix + runbook (03/26 EOD)
2) alex: telemetry, alerts, audit schema (03/28)
3) devsec: Rotate service principal + verify secrets (03/28 window)
4) tanya: customer comms after hotfix verification
5) cadence: weekly token-health check-ins starting 03/30 for 6 weeks

if anything slips, update the sheet and ping me. thanks all.
